verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-hosting model gives users full control over where data lives and who can access it, and the vendor explicitly states 'Keep your data private... decide who has access to it,' plus you can delete/restore components within files. But there is no documented retention-policy tooling, account/data deletion API, or GDPR-style data export/erasure workflow for the SaaS offering. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy settings, documented data deletion/export API or account-deletion flow, compliance certifications (SOC2/GDPR) addressing retention.
